assumptions: Events are stored with a time channel (else the event number stands for time, as in FlowJo).
limits: FlowJo's Auto-Range (ranges fitted to peaks) is not built: its rule is unpublished.
bio.jane/contract.question: How does this channel change over the acquisition, and what are its peak, slope and area in each time range?

description: One channel over acquisition time (FlowJo Kinetics): median, mean, geometric mean, a percentile or % above a threshold in equal time bins, optionally gated above the threshold and smoothed; per time range the peak and its time, mean, slope, AUC and dt.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

above_threshold_only.description: the statistic of events above T only.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

channel.description: the channel followed (PnN, PnS or a derived name); empty for the first fluorescence channel.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

half_width.description: smoothing window, ± bins (Gaussian σ = half of it).

kinetic_bins.description: equal time bins over the population’s time span.

percentile.description: for statistic = percentile. Only applies when statistic is percentile.

population.description: the population; empty for all events.

ranges.description: time ranges `start-end` separated by `;`, in the time unit (seconds).

smoothing.description: curve smoothing. Values: none (none), movingAverage (moving average), gaussian (Gaussian).

statistic.description: the statistic per time bin. Values: median (median), mean (mean), geomean (geometric mean), percentile (percentile), percentAbove (% above T).

threshold.description: the threshold T. Values: none (none), absolute (a value), percentileOfRange (a percentile of a time range).

threshold_percentile.description: the percentile of the range that sets T. Only applies when threshold is percentileOfRange.

threshold_range.description: which range (1-based) the percentile is taken from. Only applies when threshold is percentileOfRange.

threshold_value.description: T as a channel scale value. Only applies when threshold is absolute.

name: flow_cytometry_kinetics

bins.description: per time bin: start, end, center, events, events used, value

ranges.description: per range: start, end, dt, peak, peak t, mean Y, slope, AUC

threshold.description: the threshold T used (0 when none)
